title: AttemptRecord artifact
description: The compacted substitute for a raw transcript. Written by the orchestrator after each Attempt and carried into the next Attempt's prompt in place of the previous conversation (FR-074). Roughly eighty tokens replace several thousand, and it is a better prompt: it states the conclusion instead of asking the model to re-derive it from a transcript it already misread once.

failure_summary.description: One or two lines. The assertion or error, not the trace.

learned.description: The conclusion to carry forward, stated as a fact about the codebase rather than as an instruction.
